label: Night Lighting
description: Night keys — ambient skylight, practicals and artificial sources, each with its color cast and falloff behavior.

items.name: blue-hour
items.text: The deep cool ambience of blue hour, the sky itself the only soft source bathing every surface in even cobalt, while any practical light burns warm orange by contrast.

items.name: neon-wash
items.text: A layered wash of colored light from dense overlapping neon signs, magenta and cyan crossing from opposite sides, saturated reflections doubling in every glossy surface.

items.name: single-neon-sign
items.text: One buzzing neon sign as the only source, its saturated color modeling the near side of the subject and dying within a few meters, the sign burning a second time in reflection on wet ground or glass.

items.name: full-moon
items.text: A clear cold night under a full moon, one soft blue-white key from high above casting long low-contrast shadows, highlights silvered and shadow detail still readable.

items.name: headlights-only
items.text: A pitch-black environment lit solely by the vehicle's own headlights and taillights, twin hard beams tunneling forward through the dark while red glow pools behind.

items.name: chiaroscuro
items.text: Dramatic chiaroscuro from a single hard practical, one side modeled in bright relief while the rest of the scene falls immediately to black.

items.name: aurora-curtains
items.text: Curtains of aurora rippling green and violet across the sky, enough skyglow to rim every upward-facing edge while the ground holds deep blue shadow.

items.name: storm-light-break
items.text: Heavy night storm cloud with directional light breaking through one small gap, a single drifting pool of illumination surrounded by darkness.

items.name: sodium-vapor
items.text: The characteristic monochrome-orange wash of sodium-vapor streetlights, color collapsing to amber inside each pool beneath a mast, deep shadow gaps between them.

items.name: led-street
items.text: Crisp cool-white LED streetlighting, clean hard-edged pools of illumination with sharp cutoff lines and a modern, slightly clinical contrast.

items.name: gas-station-canopy
items.text: The fluorescent island of a gas-station canopy at night, hard even downlight snapping color and specular detail inside its pool while blackness presses in beyond the apron.

items.name: shop-window-glow
items.text: Soft spill from a lit shop window, a broad warm side-key raking the subject on the dark street, display colors reflected back as gentle fill.

items.name: stadium-floods
items.text: Banks of stadium floodlights crossing from four high masts, every object throwing a rosette of overlapping pale hard-edged shadows, the air above the lamps glowing with insect-flecked haze.
